California Court Upholds Weinstein Rape Conviction, Orders Resentencing

A California appeals court has affirmed Harvey Weinstein's rape conviction but ruled that he must be resentenced. This decision follows a separate development in New York, where prosecutors opted not to pursue a fourth trial against Weinstein. The New York case, part of the #MeToo era, was dropped after the accuser stated she was unable to testify again.
